name: Yu-Gi-Oh! GO RUSH!!
description: Twins Yuhi and Yuamu Ohdo believe there's alien life beyond the stars, even though their attempts to prove it have only ended in failure; their hard work and dedication are about to pay off when an extraterrestrial finally arrives on Earth!

videos.title: Meet the Ultraterrestrial Tracker Squad
videos.overview: Twins Yuhi and Yuamu Ohdo believe there's life beyond the stars - and their wildest dreams!

videos.title: The Secrecy
videos.overview: Yudias must Rush Duel against a super-secret organization - The Secrecy!

videos.title: The Kebobbery!
videos.overview: When a mysterious alien steals UTS's dinner - revenge is on the menu!

videos.title: Trap Tutorial
videos.overview: Yudias gets sidetracked by a tricky alien who gives him a tutorial on traps!

videos.title: All Washed Up!
videos.overview: Yuhi comes face-to-face with a mad scientist who wants him to be his next experiment!

videos.title: Three Terrifying Tales
videos.overview: UTS get their spook on when they set out to solve some urban legends!

videos.title: Training Troubles
videos.overview: It's time for trivia as Yuhi tests Yudias's knowledge of Rush Duels!

videos.title: Showdown with a Star!
videos.overview: When a famous celebrity arrives in town, Yuamu steps up to the challenge to duel her on TV!

videos.title: Doggy Duel!
videos.overview: It's a battle to see who's top dog when a canine from across the cosmos takes on Maddox!

videos.title: Earthdama Drama
videos.overview: Yudias risks more than his life points when Chupataro is able to make his monster become real!

videos.title: Testing Time!
videos.overview: As Yudias prepares for his biggest battle ever, Immi puts his skills to the ultimate test!

videos.title: The Grand Plan
videos.overview: Yudias and Zuwijo battle it out in a Rush Duel that has galactic consequences!

videos.title: Wrath of the Requiem
videos.overview: With the power of the Earthdama, Zuwijo and his sinister monster have Yudias on the verge of defeat!

videos.title: The Next Case
videos.overview: It's a missing person's case when UTS is hired for a dangerous mission.

videos.title: The Alien Underground
videos.overview: UTS travels to the deep dark underground of Mutsuba Town to find a missing girl - but find trouble instead!

videos.title: Sky Sky Sky
videos.overview: There's something spooky going on at UTS when a ghost haunts their headquarters!

videos.title: The Info Broker
videos.overview: Desperate to find Yuna Goha, Yuamu duels against the info broker - an alien who knows everything about everything!

videos.title: Eye See All
videos.overview: When Yuhi has to duel a prophet, how can he win against an opponent who can read the future?

videos.title: The Big Boss
videos.overview: Maddox faces off against an opponent who has never lost a match - his boss!

videos.title: The Rovian Bandit
videos.overview: UTS comes face-to-face with a Rovian Bandit who will stop at nothing to end their quest to find the missing Yuna Goha!

videos.title: Mission: Find Yudias
videos.overview: When Yudias goes missing, it's up to Yuhi and Yuamu to find him - even if it means going to the most dangerous place in the alien underground!

videos.title: The Queen of Powloon Castle
videos.overview: It's a two-on-one duel as Yuhi and Yuamu battle the leader of the Rovian Bandits!

videos.title: Ramen Rumble
videos.overview: It's a ramen rumble as UTS takes on a Rovian Bandit who knows his way around noodles!

videos.title: My Friend Got Turned into a T-Shirt
videos.overview: UTS must iron out a way to save Yudias after discovering he's been turned into a T-shirt!

videos.title: The Takeover
videos.overview: The Rovian Bandits have come up from the alien underground to take over UTS!

videos.title: Secret of the Space Treasure
videos.overview: The mystery of the Space Treasure is finally revealed - and it's truly out of this world!

videos.title: How to Make a Cartoon
videos.overview: Chupataro draws up an idea to create the best Miss Mutton cartoon ever!

videos.title: Old School Duel
videos.overview: When Yuhi loses his Duel Disk, he has to duel old school against Asaka!

videos.title: Rubble Trouble
videos.overview: Yudias takes on a stone stacking duelist who rocks at Rush Duels!

videos.title: The Redeem Queen
videos.overview: Yuamu needs one last plate to complete her collection, but the Redeem Queen's dream is about to be shattered into pieces!

videos.title: Remote Rush Duel
videos.overview: It's a duel a gazillion miles in the making as Asaka and Ranran battle it out in a Remote Rush Duel!

videos.title: The Great King of Terror
videos.overview: UTS comes face-to-face with the most terrifying terror in the universe - The Great King of Terror!

videos.title: Jurassic Plastic
videos.overview: It's the next duel for the fate of Planet Earth when Immi has to duel against The Hobbysaurus!

videos.title: Are You Kitten' Me?
videos.overview: The claws come out when Maddox duels against an unexpected foe - his best friend The Meowdestar!

videos.title: Learning About London
videos.overview: London's suspicious schemes finally come to light as his secret plan is revealed!

videos.title: To Freeze or Not to Freeze
videos.overview: Team Earth and Team Terror team up to take down The Luug!

videos.title: The Zuwijo
videos.overview: The Zuwijo manipulates The Luug to spread chaos like never before!

videos.title: A Cool Duel
videos.overview: Yudias and Yuna battle in a tag team duel against The Luug and... The Luug!

videos.title: Who's That Guy?
videos.overview: Just when all hope seems lost, can a surprise duelist save the day?

videos.title: Summoning Spectacle
videos.overview: Yuhi and Yudias enter the Rush Duel dojo to train in one of the most important parts of the duel- their summoning speeches!

videos.title: Planet Meowmeowmeow
videos.overview: UTS heads to Meowdestar's home planet to unfreeze her friends and family!

videos.title: The Courier
videos.overview: In search of a rare mineral, UTS lands on a deserted planet - only to discover they're not alone!

videos.title: Hearing Whispers
videos.overview: When Ranran starts hearing voices in her head, is she going crazy? Or is someone trying to take over her mind?

videos.title: Operation Yudias
videos.overview: One of the strongest armadas in the galaxy invades Yudias's spaceship to capture him and it's up to his friends to make sure they don't!

videos.title: Decisions, Decisions
videos.overview: To duel or not to duel: that is the question! But when UTS goes up against the most indecisive decision maker they've ever met, the answer is nowhere in sight!

videos.title: Who Is the Earthdama?
videos.overview: Someone has been possessed by the Earthdama, and it's up to Maddox to find out who!

videos.title: Dueling with Efficiency
videos.overview: Yuhi wants to get rid of UTS headquarters and build a skyscraper in its place!

videos.title: Playtime with Damamu
videos.overview: Yuhi and Yuamu must soothe the day when the Earthdama throws a tantrum of giant proportions!

videos.title: Rush to War
videos.overview: Yudias teams up with his friends for a galactic battle against Zuwijo!

videos.title: Rush to Retaliate
videos.overview: The Rush Duel between Yudias and Zuwijo rages on as giant spaceships clash in outer space!

videos.title: Rush to Redemption
videos.overview: The fate of every Velgearian hangs in the balance as Yudias and Zuwijo's final face-off comes to a climactic conclusion!
